title: AHP tool capture
description: A manually curated snapshot of the outputs a tool produced for one fixture, with provenance and a re-verification path. Captures record tools that cannot run in CI (closed-source, GUI-only, or hosted); every tool is recorded the same way.

fixture_id.description: The id of the fixture the tool was given.

version.description: Exact version as reported by the tool; 'undetermined' if the tool does not report one.

by.description: Who operated the tool (name or handle).

outputs.description: The tool's outputs, transcribed exactly as displayed or exported, in the same shape as the fixture's expected block.

notes.description: e.g. which outputs the tool does not display.

ri_table.description: The random-index table the tool uses, if determinable from its documentation, source, or output.

source.description: How the table was determined (documentation page, source file, support answer).

prioritization_method.description: The tool's prioritization method, if determinable (e.g. 'principal-eigenvector', 'column-normalization-mean', 'geometric-mean', 'undetermined').

matches_expected.description: Per-output comparison against the fixture's expected values. Keys are output paths (e.g. 'matrices.drinks.priorities'); each entry records whether the output is within the stated tolerance of the expected value.

compared_to.description: Which expected block was compared: 'expected' or an alternate method name.

explanation.description: REQUIRED whenever any matches_expected entry is false: the cause of the divergence, stated factually (e.g. 'uses the Alonso-Lamata RI estimates; CI and priorities match'). CI enforces this.

reverify.description: How anyone can reproduce this capture. At least one of instructions, artifacts, or url.

artifacts.description: Paths (relative to the capture file) of exported model files or screenshots in this repository.

url.description: A URL anyone can open without an account that reproduces the fixture in the tool.
